title: Hardened question pipeline and verified county borders
body:
FAIRER QUESTION TURNS
- Only valid, answered questions consume your question limit. Unverified queries, errors, and typos never deduct your turns.
- State transactions protect your last available question and ensure accurate counter tracking across guest and signed-in play.

SMARTER QUESTION UNDERSTANDING
- Improved question planning protocol (cache v26) with better resolution for country names, abbreviations, and similar locations.
- Clearer distinction between false facts and questions outside our local knowledge base.

VERIFIED POLISH COUNTY BORDERS
- Complete territorial adjacency data covering all 380 Polish counties and 1,003 verified border pairs.
- Correct distinction between land counties, city counties, and neighboring voivodeships.

GEOGRAPHY & MEMBERSHIP CORRECTIONS
- Updated island classifications and Benelux organization facts.
- Current international organizations are clearly separated from historical dissolved unions.

PERFORMANCE & ADMIN DIAGNOSTICS
- Offloaded AI and database operations from the main server loop for smoother response times.
- Added query cache and planning diagnostics in the admin dashboard.
